# TEMPLATE: CLAUDE.md for a Next.js + SQLite SaaS project

## 1. Purpose and Scope of the Template
This file is the default `CLAUDE.md`... It tells Claude Code to treat the repository as production-oriented SaaS, not demo. Target stack: Next.js 14 App Router, React 18, TypeScript 5.4 strict, Tailwind CSS 3.4, Drizzle ORM with better-sqlite3. Database file default `./data/local.db` ... Example: if Claude adds a page, it must be under `src/app/(dashboard)/projects/page.tsx`, not pages router.

## 2. Required Project Conventions
... File layout table? Need concrete examples. Use import alias `@/`. Component naming PascalCase, files kebab-case? Choose one. Server actions in `src/actions/*.ts` named exports: `createProject`, `deleteProject`. No default export for server actions. API route example `src/app/api/projects/route.ts` returns `NextResponse.json({ id }, { status: 201 })`. UI components use Tailwind utility classes; if adding new design token, update `tailwind.config.ts` not inline arbitrary values unless necessary.

## 3. SQLite Data Layer Rules
... schema in `src/db/schema.ts`; migrations under `drizzle/`; connection in `src/db/index.ts` opens better-sqlite3 with `db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL');`. Example:
```ts
export const tenants = sqliteTable("tenants", { id: text().primaryKey(), name: text().notNull() });
export const projects = sqliteTable("projects", { id: text().primaryKey(), tenantId: text("tenant_id").notNull().references(() => tenants.id), title: text().notNull(), deletedAt: integer("deleted_at", { mode: "timestamp" }) });
```
Query helper must filter by tenant: `db.select().from(projects).where(and(eq(projects.tenantId, tenantId), isNull(projects.deletedAt)))`. Writes use
